result.summary: Found 3 layout issues where content is cut off or extends beyond the visible viewport, affecting the user experience and content visibility.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right side of the screen, making the delivery time badge and restaurant image not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card layout to ensure all three cards fit properly within the viewport, or implement proper horizontal scrolling with visible scroll indicators

issues.description: The category filter row has a partially visible category button on the far right that extends beyond the screen, indicating there's more content not shown
issues.suggestion: Either make the category buttons fit the full width, implement horizontal scrolling, or hide the overflow with proper pagination indicators

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom of the visible area, with incomplete content showing
issues.suggestion: Ensure proper spacing and padding at the bottom of the scrollable content area, or implement proper page height management to show complete cards
